subject: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novahealth.org>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path

Emily / Sarah team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on outcomes and procurement path.

TL;DR:
- Executive sponsor: Dr. Sarah Patel is aligned to business outcomes and will be our executive champion.
- Pilot goal: 8-week MVP to reduce triage time for intake forms by ~40% and surface high-risk patients earlier.
- Primary constraints: PHI/data residency concerns, procurement timeline (procurement lead: Mark Rivera), and SOC2 / security evidence for vendor review.

Pain points we heard:
- Manual triage is inconsistent across sites and creating delayed care windows.
- Current vendor tooling can't meet our latency SLA for near-real-time triage at peak load.
- Procurement needs standardized security artifacts (SOC2, data flow, retention policies).

Business outcomes / success criteria (agreed):
- 40% reduction in triage turnaround for pilot cohort.
- No PHI exfiltration; data remains in agreed region.
- Clear runbook for escalation and rollback.

Procurement & timeline:
- Procurement lead: Mark Rivera (procure@novahealth.org) — requested by end of next week to start legal review.
- Target: pilot kickoff in mid-May (Q2) — internal approval required by May 3.
- Required artifacts: pricing sheet, security checklist, SOC2 summary.

Risks / escalation items:
- Data residency / PHI: must confirm whether NovaHealth will host data on-prem or in a specific cloud region.
- SLA exceptions for peak: we may need a small Dedicated pool to meet latency during peak hours.
- Contract timeline: if procurement takes longer than 3 weeks, pilot start will slip.

Attachments I shared: NH-MA-MVP-pricing-v1.pdf (pricing/tiers) and NovaHealth-Security-Checklist.xlsx (security questionnaire stub).

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Marissa: share finalized pricing & SOC2 summary for procurement (by 2027-03-01).
- Aditya (cc): schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with platform + infra engineers (propose Mar 8-10).
- Laura (cc): prepare standard SOW + any contract notes for procurement review (by 2027-03-03).
- Emily / Sarah: confirm procurement contact (Mark) and whether data residency requires on-prem pilot (by 2027-03-01).

If that looks right, we’ll lock the dates and I’ll send calendar invites for the technical deep-dive and procurement kickoff.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and captures the conversation. Quick answers/clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: Dr. Sarah Patel will be the executive sponsor and will participate in the procurement kickoff.
- Procurement lead: Mark Rivera (cc’d) — he’ll lead legal/contract reviews.
- Timeline: Q2 pilot still looks achievable, aiming for a mid-May kickoff; procurement wants the pricing + security pack by next Wednesday (Mar 3).
- Data residency / PHI: likely need data to remain in our AWS GovCloud region for the pilot; I’ll confirm by Tuesday but consider that the default assumption.

Outstanding asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can support GovCloud residency for a Q2 pilot?
- Please include SOC2 Type II summary and any encryption/KMS details in the security checklist.

Appreciate the clear next steps — Mark, will you confirm the procurement timeline on your side?

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Exec sponsor alignment & procurement path

Thanks Emily — great, appreciate the confirmations. A few clarifications and firm next steps so procurement and execs have what they need.

1) GovCloud support: short answer — yes. We support GovCloud deployments via our Private offering (customer-controlled VPC). Aditya will lead the technical mapping on network/KMS and confirm exact data flow.

2) Security artifacts: I’ve attached the SOC2 summary + security checklist. Laura — I’ve asked you to draft the SOW template and highlight any non-standard clauses for Mark’s team.

3) Pricing and commercial path: attached pricing (NH-MA-MVP-pricing-v1.pdf) includes a pilot tier and an optional Dedicated pool add-on (recommended to guarantee latency at peak). If procurement is comfortable with the pilot, we can convert pilot credits into a 12-month committed Dedicated contract with a 20% discount.

4) Escalation path (if we hit the risks listed):
- Data residency/KMS questions -> Aditya (SRE/Infra) -> escalate to our Security lead (Laura will flag if we need a formal SOC2 attestation).
- SLA exceptions -> propose temporary dedicated capacity; commercial to approve credits to cover pilot peak-hours.

Concrete next steps / calendar invites:
- Aditya to send 1-hr technical deep-dive invite (topics: GovCloud network setup, KMS integration, latency profile) — target Mar 9, 10am PT.
- Laura to send SOW + security packet to Mark and legal (target Mar 3).
- Marissa to send final pricing + SOC2 summary to Mark/Procurement (target Mar 3).

Mark / Procurement: please confirm the legal review turnaround (target <= 2 weeks) and if you need a non-disclosure or data processing addendum ahead of the SOW.

If that aligns, I’ll send calendar invites and a short one-pager for execs summarizing outcomes and risk mitigations.

Best —
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
